personas.name: Mom
personas.blurb: Checks where you are and says dinner is waiting

lines.text: Hi sweetheart! There you are. I was just about to text you.
Where are you right now? Are you still on your way?
Okay, good. Keep walking, I'm watching the clock. Dinner's almost ready.
Mm-hm. Yeah, no, that's fine. Just stay on the phone with me until you get here.
Did you eat already? Because there's plenty.
Right. Okay. How far is it now, like five minutes?
Perfect. I'll keep the porch light on. Don't hang up, okay?

personas.name: Alex
personas.blurb: A friend who is waiting out front for you

lines.text: Hey! Finally. I've been waiting out front for like ten minutes.
Where are you? Which street are you on?
Okay, I know exactly where that is. You're really close. Just keep going straight.
I'm right by the entrance. I'll wave when I see you.
Yeah, no, take your time. I'm not going anywhere.
Okay, I think I can see you down the block. Is that you?
Good. Stay on the phone till you get here, okay?

personas.name: Sam
personas.blurb: Your roommate, up and waiting by the door

lines.text: Hey, it's me. Are you almost home?
I figured. I'm up anyway, so I'll wait for you.
Which way are you coming, past the corner store?
Okay, yeah, that's the right way. Perfect.
I'm literally standing by the door. I'll unlock it when you're close.
Yeah, stay on with me until you're here. No rush.
Okay, so like two minutes. I'll be at the door.
